title: Health agents sit in outside Direction de la Solde, Plateau, Abidjan
location: outside Direction de la Solde, Plateau, Abidjan
organizer: Comité national des agents de santé de Côte d’Ivoire
threshold_50_evidence: KOACI reports over 2,000 as the workforce affected nationwide, not sit-in attendees. Actual turnout is not given; threshold remains unverified.

occurrence_and_date.value: KOACI on-site account describes sit-in on 18 Dec 2020 outside payroll directorate in Plateau.

demand.value: Health agents employed by ministries other than Health sought nine months of COVID-bonus arrears.

attendance.value: More than 2,000 refers to affected agents nationwide; no sit-in headcount given.

state_interaction.value: Organizers were received by payroll officials; another meeting was offered for following Wednesday. No resolution documented in opened report.

title: Health workers at CHU de Yopougon strike and block access to the hospital site
organizer: health workers; organization not identified in opened report
threshold_50_evidence: YECLO reports a strike and site access blockade but does not provide a count. Number of participants is unknown.

occurrence_and_date.value: YECLO page says CHU de Yopougon health agents began a strike on 21 Dec and blocked access.

demand.value: Payment of announced COVID bonus; government explanation cited administrative omission and processing issues.

event_relation.value: Do not assume same participants or continuous action as Dec 18 Plateau sit-in; overlap is unverified.
